newsitem.title: SPAIN: ETA kidnap victim found shot in head in Spain.
newsitem.headline: ETA kidnap victim found shot in head in Spain.

text.p: Rescue workers said on Saturday a kidnapped politician had been found shot in the head with his hands tied but could not confirm if he was alive or dead.
Basque guerrillas ETA had kidnapped Miguel Angel Blanco on Thursday and threatened to kill him at 4 p.m. (1400 GMT) on Saturday if the government did not change its prison policy.
